sources.title: Gemma 4 model overview - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of generative artificial intelligence models and you can use them in a wide variety of generation tasks, including question answering, summarization, and reasoning. Gemma models are provided with open weights and permit responsible commercial use, allowing you to tune and deploy them in your own projects and applications. sources.title: Gemma 4 model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B. Their diverse sizes make them deployable in environments ranging from high-end phones to laptops and servers, democratizing access to state-of-the-art AI. sources.title: Gemma 4 E2B — Ultra-Lightweight Local AI | gemma4.dev
sources.snippet: Models /Gemma 4 E2B Gemma 4 E2B — Ultra-Lightweight Local AI Gemma 4 E2B packs 2.1 billion parameters into the smallest footprint in the Gemma 4 family. Text-only, 8K context, and capable of running entirely on CPU — making it the go-to model for edge devices, embedded systems, and ultra-low-latency applications.
